entries.speaker: Special Obstacles in Palaces
entries.en: Occasionally, you will encounter [clr 2]Palace obstacles[n]that are impassable and require interacting with[n]the target in the real world[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Special Obstacles in Palaces
entries.en: You will need to leave the Palace to find the[n]obstruction. Enter Palaces quickly to find[n]obstacles and triumph over challenges before[n]the deadline.
